papers.title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: The rapid development of large language models and multimodal large language models has accelerated the emergence of proactive agents capable of operating everyday tools and assisting users in real-world environments. However, existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate such agents effectively, as they often rely on sandboxed environments and single-turn evaluation paradigms. Moreover, their scenario-based task taxonomies mix multiple model capabilities within the same task category, making it diff
papers.llm_reason: UniClawBench 直击当前 Agent 工程最大评测缺口：现有基准普遍依赖沙箱环境与单轮评测，而真实主动式 Agent 是多轮、多工具、跨环境的长程任务。它把评测从‘单能力点’重构为‘按能力正交分解的任务分类法’，对任何自研 Agent 团队都是可立刻对照的评测骨架。证据强度中等：提出新基准并给出任务分类，但代码/数据集链接暂缺（待核验），尚无外部复现。属强趋势信号——主动式 Agent 评测正成为独立赛道，纳入趋势雷达连续观察。

papers.title: SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization
papers.abstract: Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss. Existing training-time low-rank regularizers can improve compressibility, but they often require SVDs of large weight matrices, modify the model architecture (introducing additional trainable parameters), or rely on stateful cached quantities. To address these limitations, we introduce SLORR, a simple, stateless, and
papers.llm_reason: SLORR 是工程落地性最强的一篇：训练期低秩正则化，无需 SVD、不改架构、不引入额外可训练参数、无状态缓存，直接在现有训练流水线上‘即插即用’提升模型对低秩分解的友好度，从而降低压缩后的精度损失。对推理成本敏感的部署场景（边缘、高并发）有直接操作价值。证据强度偏中上：方法设计明确且消融了与 SVD 类正则化器的对比，但 2026-07 新发，缺少跨大模型尺度（数十亿以上）验证与开源代码（待核验）。按即时价值试点：可在自有 SFT/预训练流水线做最小插入实验。

papers.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
papers.abstract: Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure. We present IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a benchmark for scientific lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation. papers.llm_reason: IdeaGene-Bench 把‘科学思想的遗传结构’变成可评测对象：每篇论文/提案表示为一组最小可继承单元（IdeaGene），评测模型能否沿谱系做推理与受谱系约束的创意生成。理论新颖度高，且与 RAG/知识图谱、研究型 Agent、合成数据构造三条主线相关。证据强度中等：提供基准与框架，但‘思想基因组’的分解粒度本身带有主观性，跨领域泛化待核验。更偏趋势资产——它指向‘AI 科研助手需要理解思想血缘’这一方向，适合沉淀为研究型 Agent 的评测维度。

papers.title: AUTOPILOT VQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Incident-Centric Dashcam Understanding
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models, Large Language Models, and Multimodal Large Language Models have improved autonomous driving tasks such as scene understanding, decision making, trajectory prediction, and visual question answering. However, evaluating whether these models can reliably reason about safety-critical incidents remains challenging. To address this gap, we present AUTOPILOT-VQA, an incident-centric visual question answering benchmark for dashcam video understanding. The data
papers.llm_reason: AUTOPILOT-VQA 把 VLM 评测聚焦到‘安全攸关的事故场景’而非一般场景理解，填补了自动驾驶 VQA 在事故推理上的空白。对做安全治理、多模态 Agent 与具身评测的团队是直接可对照的基准思路。证据强度中等：围绕真实行车录像构建事故中心化问答，但规模与标注协议细节、数据集开放性（待核验）将决定其可复现性。作为趋势信号价值高——安全攸关多模态评测正从‘通用能力榜’走向‘高风险子能力专项榜’。

papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
papers.abstract: While UMAP is widely used for exploring high-dimensional data, typical workflows focus on its lower-dimensional embedding, largely overlooking the rich k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graph that UMAP constructs internally. This graph encodes the data manifold in its original high-dimensional space, before the distortion that UMAP's 2D projection introduces. papers.llm_reason: 指出 UMAP 内部构建的 kNN 图被普遍浪费——多数流程只用最终 2D 投影，而 kNN 图保留了高维流形的原始拓扑（投影会引入畸变）。把标准图算法（社区发现、中心性、路径）作用到这张图上可显著增强数据语义构建与异常发现。工程价值在于可复用：RAG 语料聚类、评测集去重/分层、数据质量巡检都能直接套用。证据强度中等偏弱：偏系统化展示与案例（sensemaking），非大规模受控实验；作者含可视化领域资深研究者。属高资产转化率的长尾保存——即使短期不火，作为‘数据探索工具箱’可长期复用。

papers.title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Generating realistic 3D human motions in real-time within interactive applications is key for animation, simulation, and humanoid robotics. While recent offline motion generation approaches offer precise control via text and kinematic constraints, they lack the inference speed required for interactive settings. papers.title: MulTTiPop: A Multitrack Transcription Dataset for Pop Music
papers.abstract: We present MulTTiPop, a dataset of pop music segments and their associated multitrack MIDI recordings for the evaluation of automatic music transcription models. MulTTiPop contains 572 segments of popular music totaling 3.5 hours of audio, and contains songs from diverse genres and decades from the 1930s to 2000s. papers.title: Using AI-based Learning Assistants in Higher Education: A Large-Scale Descriptive Analysis
papers.abstract: In this study, we present a large-scale descriptive analysis of the use of an AI-based learning assistant (Syntea) in higher education. Based on objective log data from 77,543 students enrolled in distance studies, we examine usage patterns across gender, age group, study cluster, degree, and study mode. papers.title: Score Accuracy Along the Forward Diffusion Does Not Certify Numerical Stability in Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract: Score matching controls average error under the forward marginals, but a discretized reverse-time sampler evaluates the learned score along its own trajectory. We show that small forward-marginal error does not guarantee numerical stability. We construct a single smooth score field with arbitrarily small forward-marginal $L^2$ error. papers.title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
papers.abstract: Reasoning has become a core capability for large models, especially when reliable decisions require understanding logical consequences. Recent video generation models offer a reasoning path distinct from previous Chain-of-Thought (CoT): reasoning can unfold through temporally connected frames, known as Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning.
